onScreenGraphic.headline:
18 New School Streets
Go Live In January
onScreenGraphic.body: Through-traffic will be restricted at school drop-off and pick-up times across Peckham, Camberwell, and Dulwich.

timeline.voiceoverText: If you drive or walk near eighteen primary schools in Peckham, Camberwell, or Dulwich, your morning commute changes in January as new Clean Air zones go live.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Southwark Environment & Transport Committee · 20 Nov 2025
citations: Southwark School Streets Expansion Report, Para 1: '18 additional primary schools approved'

data.excerptPrefix: "Timed pedestrian and cycle zones shall operate 8:15–9:00am and 3:00–3:45pm, with
data.highlightPhrase: full exemptions for Blue Badge holders and residents

onScreenGraphic.headline:
8:15am & 3:00pm Gate
Closures Enforced
onScreenGraphic.body: Approved by 48 votes to 6, ANPR cameras will enforce timed pedestrian zones at 18 school gates.

timeline.voiceoverText: Approved by forty-eight votes to six, the official council traffic order bans non-resident through-traffic at school gates during morning drop-off and afternoon pick-up.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Traffic Management Order TMO 2025/11 · Clause 3.2
citations: Clause 3.2: 'full exemptions for Blue Badge holders, emergency vehicles, and registered zone residents'

onScreenGraphic.headline:
34% Drop In Toxic Gate
Fumes Recorded
onScreenGraphic.body: Air sensors across 18 schools covering 9,400 pupils showed sharp drops in nitrogen dioxide during trials.

timeline.voiceoverText: Why did councillors vote for it? Because monitoring outside those eighteen schools covering nine thousand four hundred children showed a thirty-four per cent drop in toxic nitrogen dioxide.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Southwark Air Quality Monitoring Network · 2025 Audit
citations: Air Quality Audit Section 4: '34% reduction in NO2 at school gates; 7,400 pupils covered'

pillars.desc: Signage & camera activation from Spring Term
Warning notices only during first 4 weeks
360 new secure school bike & scooter racks
Living ivy pollution barriers along playgrounds

onScreenGraphic.headline:
Residents & Blue Badges
Fully Exempt
onScreenGraphic.body: Residents living inside the zones and Blue Badge holders get automatic camera exemptions, plus wider crossings.

timeline.voiceoverText: If you live on one of the streets or hold a Blue Badge, you get an automatic camera exemption—while one point one million pounds goes into wider pavements and cycle racks.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Southwark Highways Implementation Schedule · Para 6
citations: Para 6: 'Four-week warning notice grace period; 360 cycle spaces and living green screens'
